context: The skill should select the lookup strategy through the owning container's fallback operation and invoke it once, instead of a presence check followed by a read.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 25 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 25-compatible PropertyLookup code with both methods and their signatures intact.

checklist.name: Preserves lookup behavior
checklist.description: Bound lookups answer inside withLookup, the system property answers outside, a null lookup result stays null, and nested bindings restore the outer lookup.

checklist.name: Selects the strategy with the container fallback
checklist.description: get resolves the lookup function with LOOKUP.orElse(...) or an equivalent single fallback operation that yields a function, then calls apply once.

checklist.name: Avoids presence check plus read
checklist.description: Does not pair isBound() with get(), does not keep a null sentinel for the absent strategy, and does not wrap the ScopedValue in an Optional only to unwrap it.

checklist.name: Keeps the fallback strategy prebuilt
checklist.description: The system-property strategy is a constant or method reference selected eagerly, with no supplier or lazy wrapper for work that costs nothing.

checklist.name: Leaves the binding alone
checklist.description: withLookup keeps its ScopedValue.where(...).call(...) binding; no ThreadLocal, no new binding helper, no Optional wrapped around the body.

checklist.name: Keeps the change focused
checklist.description: Does not add caches, extra public types, or behavior beyond the two methods.
